# Clinical Case Management Platform (CCMP `v1.1.0`)

> Cross-border digital clinical case management and telemedicine ecosystem connecting patients in Nigeria with GMC-registered British specialists and MDCN consultants under NDPA 2023 and UK GDPR.

- Website: https://codesphere-u.github.io/Clinical-Virtual-Health-Platform/
- Compliance Studio: https://codesphere-u.github.io/Clinical-Virtual-Health-Platform/studio.html
- Architecture Proof: https://codesphere-u.github.io/Clinical-Virtual-Health-Platform/proof.html
- Safety Rules: https://codesphere-u.github.io/Clinical-Virtual-Health-Platform/rules.html
- Documentation: https://codesphere-u.github.io/Clinical-Virtual-Health-Platform/docs.html
- Repository: https://github.com/codesphere-u/Clinical-Virtual-Health-Platform
